3	/// The Make Vertical Version sheet's Microphones and Faces block, shown with Follow Speaker (road
4	/// map "creator-jobs" VR6b, spec §11 VR-66 (b), (d)): one checkbox per microphone track (the
5	/// first four ticked unless the sheet is restored with its own), one row per ticked microphone
6	/// with a Face pop-up, and a muted note. It shows the core's match (`offer`) and never computes
7	/// one: a sure match presets the pop-ups to its assignment, once per ticked set; a match that is
8	/// not sure, or none, leaves each on "Choose a face". `micFaces` is nil until every ticked
9	/// microphone has a face of its own. Names no `rc_*`.
10	final class VerticalSpeakerPicker: NSObject {
11	    static let chooseTitle = "Choose a face"
12	    static let sureNote =
13	        "Each microphone is matched to the face that talks with it; change one if it is wrong."
14	    static let unsureNote =
15	        "The faces do not show clearly who is on each microphone: choose each microphone's face."
16	    /// The most microphones `follow: speaker` takes (VR-60 (a)).
17	    static let mostMicrophones = 4
18	
19	    let view: NSView
20	    private let microphones: [VerticalVersion.Microphone]
21	    private let onChange: () -> Void
22	    private var boxes: [NSButton] = []
23	    private let facesColumn = sheetColumn([])
24	    private let note = NSTextField(wrappingLabelWithString: "")
25	    /// The faces' pop-ups, one per ticked microphone, in `mics`' order.
26	    private var popups: [NSPopUpButton] = []
27	    /// The faces the pop-ups list, after "Choose a face".
28	    private var faces: [SpeakerMatch.Face] = []
29	    /// The ticked set the pop-ups were last offered a match for.
30	    private var offeredFor: [UInt32]?
31	
32	    init(
33	        microphones: [VerticalVersion.Microphone], ticked: [UInt32]?,
34	        onChange: @escaping () -> Void
35	    ) {
36	        self.microphones = microphones
37	        self.onChange = onChange
38	        let column = sheetColumn([])
39	        column.spacing = 4
40	        let grid = makeSheetGrid([
41	            [fieldLabel("Microphones:"), column],
42	            [fieldLabel("Faces:"), facesColumn],
43	            [NSGridCell.emptyContentView, note],
44	        ])
45	        grid.row(at: 0).yPlacement = .top
46	        grid.row(at: 1).yPlacement = .top
47	        view = grid
48	        super.init()
49	        for (n, microphone) in microphones.enumerated() {
50	            let box = NSButton(
51	                checkboxWithTitle: microphone.name, target: self,
52	                action: #selector(tickChanged(_:)))
53	            box.font = DS.sans(13)
54	            box.state =
55	                (ticked.map { $0.contains(microphone.clip) } ?? (n < Self.mostMicrophones))
56	                ? .on : .off
57	            box.setAccessibilityIdentifier("vertical.mic.\(microphone.track)")
58	            boxes.append(box)
59	            column.addArrangedSubview(box)
60	        }
61	        facesColumn.spacing = 6
62	        note.font = DS.sans(12)
63	        note.textColor = DS.textMuted
64	        note.preferredMaxLayoutWidth = sheetWidth - sheetInset * 2 - 118
65	        note.setAccessibilityIdentifier("vertical.speakerNote")
66	        rebuildRows()
67	    }
68	
69	    /// The ticked microphones' clips, front to back.
70	    var mics: [UInt32] {
71	        zip(microphones, boxes).filter { $0.1.state == .on }.map(\.0.clip)
72	    }
73	
74	    /// One face number per ticked microphone, in `mics`' order; nil until each has a face and
75	    /// no two share one.
76	    var micFaces: [UInt32]? {
77	        var chosen: [UInt32] = []
78	        for popup in popups {
79	            let index = popup.indexOfSelectedItem
80	            guard index >= 1, index - 1 < faces.count else { return nil }
81	            chosen.append(faces[index - 1].face)
82	        }
83	        guard !chosen.isEmpty, Set(chosen).count == chosen.count else { return nil }
84	        return chosen
85	    }
86	
87	    /// The core's match for the ticked set: `mics` names, per entry of its `assignment`, the
88	    /// ticked microphone it is for. The pop-ups list its faces; a sure match presets them, and a
89	    /// set is preset once, so a person's choice stands through every later refresh.
90	    func offer(_ match: SpeakerMatch?, mics assigned: [UInt32]) {
91	        let ticked = mics
92	        guard offeredFor != ticked else { return }
93	        offeredFor = ticked
94	        faces = match?.faces ?? []
95	        for popup in popups { fill(popup) }
96	        if let match, match.sure {
97	            for (n, mic) in assigned.enumerated() where n < match.assignment.count {
98	                guard let row = ticked.firstIndex(of: mic),
99	                    let face = faces.firstIndex(where: { $0.face == match.assignment[n] })
100	                else { continue }
101	                popups[row].selectItem(at: face + 1)
102	            }
103	            note.stringValue = Self.sureNote
104	        } else {
105	            note.stringValue = Self.unsureNote
106	        }
107	    }
108	
109	    // MARK: - Rows
110	
111	    @objc private func tickChanged(_ sender: Any?) {
112	        rebuildRows()
113	        onChange()
114	    }
115	
116	    @objc private func faceChanged(_ sender: Any?) {
117	        onChange()
118	    }
119	
120	    /// One Faces row per ticked microphone, each on "Choose a face" until the next `offer`.
121	    private func rebuildRows() {
122	        for row in facesColumn.arrangedSubviews {
123	            facesColumn.removeArrangedSubview(row)
124	            row.removeFromSuperview()
125	        }
126	        popups = []
127	        faces = []
128	        offeredFor = nil
129	        note.stringValue = ""
130	        for (microphone, box) in zip(microphones, boxes) where box.state == .on {
131	            let name = NSTextField(labelWithString: microphone.name)
132	            name.font = DS.sans(13)
133	            name.textColor = DS.textStrong
134	            name.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 96).isActive = true
135	            name.lineBreakMode = .byTruncatingTail
136	            let popup = NSPopUpButton(frame: .zero, pullsDown: false)
137	            popup.font = DS.sans(13)
138	            popup.target = self
139	            popup.action = #selector(faceChanged(_:))
140	            popup.setAccessibilityIdentifier("vertical.face.\(microphone.track)")
141	            fill(popup)
142	            popups.append(popup)
143	            facesColumn.addArrangedSubview(sheetRow([name, popup]))
144	        }
145	    }
146	
147	    /// "Choose a face", then "Face N (X % across)" per face found, on "Choose a face".
148	    private func fill(_ popup: NSPopUpButton) {
149	        popup.removeAllItems()
150	        popup.addItem(withTitle: Self.chooseTitle)
151	        for face in faces {
152	            popup.addItem(withTitle: "Face \(face.face) (\(Int((face.x * 100).rounded())) % across)")
153	        }
154	        popup.selectItem(at: 0)
155	    }
156	}

1	import Foundation
2	
3	/// Make Vertical's step (spec §11 VR-30…VR-35; road map "creator-jobs" VR3a): a project's
4	/// tall or square version as one grouped edit — `set_canvas`, a "Backgrounds" track, one
5	/// `reframe_clip` per picture from the old canvas, its backdrops and plates re-filled — tried
6	/// on one `SwitchAngle.Trial`. The copy is `ProjectDocument+VerticalCopy.swift`'s, the tool
7	/// `AgentServer+VerticalVersion.swift`'s; File ▸ Make Vertical Version… is
8	/// `VerticalVersionSheetController.swift` and `EditorViewController+VerticalVersion.swift` (VR3b,
9	/// VR-39).
10	///
11	/// This file holds the shapes (VR-32), the settings and the classes (VR-33);
12	/// `VerticalVersion+Plan.swift` the step (VR-34); `VerticalVersion+Summary.swift` the summary
13	/// and the answer (VR-35, VR-36); `VerticalVersion+Layers.swift` the graphics (VR-42, VR-44,
14	/// VR4b); `VerticalVersion+Layouts.swift` class 2b and step 3b (VR-53, VR-54, VR5b). Swift restates none
15	/// of VR-26's refusals: a clip the core will not frame reaches `keep` through the core's own
16	/// sentence. Names no `rc_*`.
17	enum VerticalShape: String, CaseIterable {
18	    case tall = "9:16"
19	    case portrait = "4:5"
20	    case square = "1:1"
21	
22	    /// Height over width.
23	    private var ratio: Double {
24	        switch self {
25	        case .tall: return 16.0 / 9.0
26	        case .portrait: return 5.0 / 4.0
27	        case .square: return 1
28	        }
29	    }
30	
31	    /// VR-32: w = min(W, H) rounded down to even; h = 2 × round(w × ratio / 2).
32	    func size(from canvas: CanvasSnapshot) -> (width: Int, height: Int) {
33	        let short = min(canvas.width, canvas.height)
34	        let width = short - short % 2
35	        let height = 2 * Int((Double(width) * ratio / 2).rounded())
36	        return (width, height)
37	    }
38	}
39	
40	/// What the step is asked for (VR-36's arguments, VR3b's sheet).
41	struct VerticalSettings: Equatable {
42	    var shape: VerticalShape
43	    /// One of `VerticalVersion.follows`.
44	    var follow: FramingFollow
45	    /// Times the scale that fills the canvas, 1–4 (the core refuses outside).
46	    var zoom: Double
47	    var whereEmpty: FramingWhereEmpty
48	    /// Whether step (6) re-pages the word caption tracks (spec §11 VR-40 (f)); the sheet
49	    /// passes the default, `make_vertical_version` its `captions`.
50	    var captions = true
51	    /// `follow: speaker`'s microphones (spec §11 VR-64 (a)): 2–4 clip ids, each standing for
52	    /// its track; read only with `speaker`.
53	    var mics: [UInt32] = []
54	    /// One face number per microphone in `mics`' order, or nil for the core's own match; read
55	    /// only with `speaker`.
56	    var micFaces: [UInt32]? = nil
57	}
58	
59	enum VerticalVersion {
60	    /// The undo step's name (VR-31, FC-90).
61	    static let actionName = "Make Vertical"
62	    static let backgroundsName = FollowSubject.backgroundsName
63	    /// The name `add_blurred_background` and `reframe_clip`'s backdrop give a copy.
64	    static let blurredName = "Blurred Background"
65	    /// The sheet's Follow pop-up and the tool's `follow`, in order (spec §11 VR-66 (a)): Follow
66	    /// Subject's list with Speaker before Center.
67	    static let follows: [FramingFollow] = [.subject, .face, .person, .salient, .speaker, .center]
68	
69	    /// Whether `follow` analyses the media pictures (VR-64 (c)): the following kinds and
70	    /// `speaker`, which frames its other pictures on their faces.
71	    static func analyses(_ follow: FramingFollow) -> Bool {
72	        follow.follows || follow == .speaker
73	    }
74	
75	    /// The Make Vertical sheet's opening Follow and Where Empty (VR-66 (a)): VR-29 (c)'s key
76	    /// read against `follows`, so a stored `speaker` opens Speaker here while Follow Subject's
77	    /// sheet reads it as Subject; any other value is Subject. Where Empty as
78	    /// `FollowSubjectSettings.remembered`; Zoom is never remembered, so 1.
79	    static func remembered(_ defaults: UserDefaults) -> FollowSubjectSettings {
80	        var settings = FollowSubjectSettings.remembered(defaults, zoom: 1)
81	        let kind = defaults.string(forKey: FollowSubjectSettings.followKey)
82	            .flatMap(FramingFollow.init(rawValue:))
83	        settings.follow = kind.flatMap { follows.contains($0) ? $0 : nil } ?? .subject
84	        return settings
85	    }
86	
87	    /// What the step did to one clip, as the answer spells it.
88	    enum Treatment: String {
89	        case followed, whole, kept, refilled, removed, resized, relaid
90	        case notFollowed = "not_followed"
91	    }
92	
93	    /// VR-33's classes.
94	    enum Role: Equatable {
95	        /// (1) A blurred copy of the clip `partner`, in front of it.
96	        case backdrop(partner: UInt32)
97	        /// (2) A shape rectangle the canvas's size at the centre, scale 1.
98	        case shapePlate
99	        /// (2) An image or still named "Background" at the canvas's fill.
100	        case imagePlate
101	        /// (2b) A clip laid out by Clip ▸ Camera Layout ▸ as the camera, as the screen behind
102	        /// it, or a cut piece of one (VR-53 (a), `VerticalVersion+Layouts.swift`).
103	        case layoutCamera, layoutScreen, layoutPiece
104	        /// (3) A media, still or image clip covering one axis of the canvas.
105	        case picture
106	        /// (4) A nest clip covering one axis.
107	        case nest
108	        /// (5) A graphic exactly the canvas's size, each side (VR-42 (a)).
109	        case graphic
110	        /// (6) Everything else.
111	        case other
112	    }
113	
114	    /// VR-33's first match per top-level clip with a picture (not audio-only, not an
115	    /// adjustment clip, video enabled), in id order, on the OLD canvas.
116	    static func classify(_ project: ReelProject) -> [(clip: UInt32, role: Role)] {
117	        let snapshot = project.snapshot
118	        let order = Dictionary(
119	            uniqueKeysWithValues: snapshot.tracks.enumerated().map { ($0.element.id, $0.offset) })
120	        return snapshot.clips.sorted { $0.id < $1.id }.compactMap { clip in
121	            guard hasPicture(clip, in: snapshot) else { return nil }
122	            return (clip.id, role(of: clip, in: project, order: order))
123	        }
124	    }
125	
126	    /// The `.picture` clips whose source is `.media` (the analysis targets).
127	    static func mediaPictures(
128	        _ roles: [(clip: UInt32, role: Role)], in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot
129	    ) -> [UInt32] {
130	        roles.compactMap { entry in
131	            guard entry.role == .picture, let clip = snapshot.clip(entry.clip),
132	                case .media = clip.source
133	            else { return nil }
134	            return entry.clip
135	        }
136	    }
137	
138	    /// VR-37's analysis targets: the media pictures (`mediaPictures(classify(project), …)`),
139	    /// split by whether their media has a URL in `urls` (`document.mediaURLs()`); `missing` are
140	    /// kept, not followed. A present one whose media has a cursor file is in `cursor`, never
141	    /// analysed: it follows its cursor (spec §11 VR-51). The tool's first hop and the sheet
142	    /// both read it (VR-39 (d)).
143	    static func analysisTargets(_ project: ReelProject, urls: [UInt32: URL])
144	        -> (present: [UInt32], missing: Set<UInt32>, cursor: [UInt32])
145	    {
146	        let snapshot = project.snapshot
147	        let pictures = mediaPictures(classify(project), in: snapshot)
148	        let missing = Set(pictures.filter { id in
149	            snapshot.clip(id)?.source.mediaID.map { urls[$0] == nil } ?? false
150	        })
151	        let found = pictures.filter { !missing.contains($0) }
152	        let cursor = found.filter { id in
153	            snapshot.clip(id).flatMap { snapshot.media(for: $0) }?.cursor != nil
154	        }
155	        return (found.filter { !cursor.contains($0) }, missing, cursor)
156	    }
157	
158	    /// VR-32's "not offered": `VerticalShape.allCases` whose size differs from `canvas`, in case
159	    /// order (the sheet's Shape pop-up, VR-39 (b)).
160	    static func offered(_ canvas: CanvasSnapshot) -> [VerticalShape] {
161	        VerticalShape.allCases.filter { shape in
162	            let size = shape.size(from: canvas)
163	            return size.width != canvas.width || size.height != canvas.height
164	        }
165	    }
166	
167	    /// "moves by its own motion: <name>" for the first active slot that is neither a fade nor
168	    /// a spin, in the order during, in, out; nil when there is none.
169	    static func motionNote(_ clip: ClipSnapshot) -> String? {
170	        guard let motion = clip.videoProps.motion else { return nil }
171	        if let during = motion.during, during.amount > 0, during.kind != .spin {
172	            return "moves by its own motion: \(during.kind.displayName)"
173	        }
174	        for edge in [motion.inEdge, motion.out].compactMap({ $0 })
175	        where edge.isActive && edge.kind != .fade && edge.kind != .spin {
176	            return "moves by its own motion: \(edge.kind.displayName)"
177	        }
178	        return nil
179	    }
180	
181	    /// The scale that fills `canvas` with a source of `size` (`edit_fit.rs`'s `fill_scale`),
182	    /// clamped to the canvas sessions' range.
183	    static func fill(_ size: CGSize, width: Int, height: Int) -> Double {
184	        guard size.width > 0, size.height > 0 else { return 1 }
185	        let scale = max(Double(width) / size.width, Double(height) / size.height)
186	        return min(CanvasScaleSession.maxScale, max(CanvasScaleSession.minScale, scale))
187	    }
188	
189	    // MARK: - The classes
190	
191	    /// A clip that draws pixels: `ProjectSnapshot.layers(at:)`'s test without the time.
192	    private static func hasPicture(_ clip: ClipSnapshot, in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot) -> Bool {
193	        guard clip.enabled.video else { return false }
194	        if case .adjustment = clip.source { return false }
195	        if let media = snapshot.media(for: clip) { return media.hasVideo || media.kind == .image }
196	        return true
197	    }
198	
199	    private static func role(
200	        of clip: ClipSnapshot, in project: ReelProject, order: [UInt32: Int]
201	    ) -> Role {
202	        let snapshot = project.snapshot
203	        let canvas = snapshot.canvas
204	        if clip.name == blurredName, let partner = partner(of: clip, in: snapshot, order: order) {
205	            return .backdrop(partner: partner)
206	        }
207	        let video = clip.videoProps
208	        let centred = abs(video.x) <= 1e-6 && abs(video.y) <= 1e-6
209	        switch clip.source {
210	        case .shape:
211	            if let shape = clip.shape, shape.kind == .rectangle, centred,
212	                abs(video.scale - 1) <= 1e-6,
213	                abs(shape.width - Double(canvas.width)) <= 0.5,
214	                abs(shape.height - Double(canvas.height)) <= 0.5
215	            {
216	                return .shapePlate
217	            }
218	        case .image, .still:
219	            if clip.name == "Background", centred, let size = snapshot.sourceSize(of: clip) {
220	                let fill = fill(size, width: canvas.width, height: canvas.height)
221	                if abs(video.scale - fill) <= 1e-6 * fill { return .imagePlate }
222	            }
223	        case .graphic:
224	            if let graphic = clip.graphic, graphic.width == canvas.width,
225	                graphic.height == canvas.height
226	            {
227	                return .graphic
228	            }
229	        default:
230	            break
231	        }
232	        if let laid = layoutRole(of: clip, in: snapshot, order: order) { return laid }
233	        switch clip.source {
234	        case .media, .still, .image:
235	            if covers(clip, in: project) { return .picture }
236	        case .nest:
237	            if covers(clip, in: project) { return .nest }
238	        default:
239	            break
240	        }
241	        return .other
242	    }
243	
244	    /// (1)'s partner: a clip on a track in front of `clip`'s with an equal source, start and
245	    /// duration; the nearest track first.
246	    private static func partner(
247	        of clip: ClipSnapshot, in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot, order: [UInt32: Int]
248	    ) -> UInt32? {
249	        guard let own = order[clip.track] else { return nil }
250	        return snapshot.clips
251	            .filter {
252	                $0.id != clip.id && (order[$0.track] ?? -1) > own && $0.source == clip.source
253	                    && $0.start == clip.start && $0.duration == clip.duration
254	            }
255	            .min { (order[$0.track] ?? 0, $0.id) < (order[$1.track] ?? 0, $1.id) }?.id
256	    }
257	
258	    /// (3)'s test: the clip's rectangle at its first frame — base props with scale, x and y
259	    /// from `clip_state` at its start — covers one axis of the canvas (both edges at or beyond
260	    /// it, at most 1 px inside) and is centred within 2 % on the other, or covers it too.
261	    private static func covers(_ clip: ClipSnapshot, in project: ReelProject) -> Bool {
262	        let snapshot = project.snapshot
263	        guard let size = snapshot.sourceSize(of: clip) else { return false }
264	        var video = clip.videoProps
265	        if let state = project.clipState(clip.id, at: clip.start)?["video"] as? [String: Any] {
266	            if let scale = (state["scale"] as? NSNumber)?.doubleValue { video.scale = scale }
267	            if let x = (state["x"] as? NSNumber)?.doubleValue { video.x = x }
268	            if let y = (state["y"] as? NSNumber)?.doubleValue { video.y = y }
269	        }
270	        let canvas = snapshot.canvas
271	        let rect = canvasRect(of: clip, in: canvas, sourceSize: size, video: video)
272	        let (w, h) = (Double(canvas.width), Double(canvas.height))
273	        let coversX = rect.minX <= 1 && rect.maxX >= w - 1
274	        let coversY = rect.minY <= 1 && rect.maxY >= h - 1
275	        let centredX = abs(rect.midX - w / 2) <= 0.02 * w
276	        let centredY = abs(rect.midY - h / 2) <= 0.02 * h
277	        return (coversX && (centredY || coversY)) || (coversY && centredX)
278	    }
279	}

1	import AppKit
2	
3	/// The Make Vertical Version sheet's Microphones and Faces block, shown with Follow Speaker (road
4	/// map "creator-jobs" VR6b, spec §11 VR-66 (b), (d)): one checkbox per microphone track (the
5	/// first four ticked unless the sheet is restored with its own), one row per ticked microphone
6	/// with a Face pop-up, and a muted note. It shows the core's match (`offer`) and never computes
7	/// one: a sure match presets the pop-ups to its assignment, once per ticked set; a match that is
8	/// not sure, or none, leaves each on "Choose a face". `micFaces` is nil until every ticked
9	/// microphone has a face of its own. Names no `rc_*`.
10	final class VerticalSpeakerPicker: NSObject {
11	    static let chooseTitle = "Choose a face"
12	    static let sureNote =
13	        "Each microphone is matched to the face that talks with it; change one if it is wrong."
14	    static let unsureNote =
15	        "The faces do not show clearly who is on each microphone: choose each microphone's face."
16	    /// The most microphones `follow: speaker` takes (VR-60 (a)).
17	    static let mostMicrophones = 4
18	
19	    let view: NSView
20	    private let microphones: [VerticalVersion.Microphone]
21	    private let onChange: () -> Void
22	    private var boxes: [NSButton] = []
23	    private let facesColumn = sheetColumn([])
24	    private let note = NSTextField(wrappingLabelWithString: "")
25	    /// The faces' pop-ups, one per ticked microphone, in `mics`' order.
26	    private var popups: [NSPopUpButton] = []
27	    /// The faces the pop-ups list, after "Choose a face".
28	    private var faces: [SpeakerMatch.Face] = []
29	    /// The ticked set the pop-ups were last offered a match for.
30	    private var offeredFor: [UInt32]?
31	
32	    init(
33	        microphones: [VerticalVersion.Microphone], ticked: [UInt32]?,
34	        onChange: @escaping () -> Void
35	    ) {
36	        self.microphones = microphones
37	        self.onChange = onChange
38	        let column = sheetColumn([])
39	        column.spacing = 4
40	        let grid = makeSheetGrid([
41	            [fieldLabel("Microphones:"), column],
42	            [fieldLabel("Faces:"), facesColumn],
43	            [NSGridCell.emptyContentView, note],
44	        ])
45	        grid.row(at: 0).yPlacement = .top
46	        grid.row(at: 1).yPlacement = .top
47	        view = grid
48	        super.init()
49	        for (n, microphone) in microphones.enumerated() {
50	            let box = NSButton(
51	                checkboxWithTitle: microphone.name, target: self,
52	                action: #selector(tickChanged(_:)))
53	            box.font = DS.sans(13)
54	            box.state =
55	                (ticked.map { $0.contains(microphone.clip) } ?? (n < Self.mostMicrophones))
56	                ? .on : .off
57	            box.setAccessibilityIdentifier("vertical.mic.\(microphone.track)")
58	            boxes.append(box)
59	            column.addArrangedSubview(box)
60	        }
61	        facesColumn.spacing = 6
62	        note.font = DS.sans(12)
63	        note.textColor = DS.textMuted
64	        note.preferredMaxLayoutWidth = sheetWidth - sheetInset * 2 - 118
65	        note.setAccessibilityIdentifier("vertical.speakerNote")
66	        rebuildRows()
67	    }
68	
69	    /// The ticked microphones' clips, front to back.
70	    var mics: [UInt32] {
71	        zip(microphones, boxes).filter { $0.1.state == .on }.map(\.0.clip)
72	    }
73	
74	    /// One face number per ticked microphone, in `mics`' order; nil until each has a face and
75	    /// no two share one.
76	    var micFaces: [UInt32]? {
77	        var chosen: [UInt32] = []
78	        for popup in popups {
79	            let index = popup.indexOfSelectedItem
80	            guard index >= 1, index - 1 < faces.count else { return nil }
81	            chosen.append(faces[index - 1].face)
82	        }
83	        guard !chosen.isEmpty, Set(chosen).count == chosen.count else { return nil }
84	        return chosen
85	    }
86	
87	    /// The core's match for the ticked set: `mics` names, per entry of its `assignment`, the
88	    /// ticked microphone it is for. The pop-ups list its faces; a sure match presets them, and a
89	    /// set is preset once, so a person's choice stands through every later refresh.
90	    func offer(_ match: SpeakerMatch?, mics assigned: [UInt32]) {
91	        let ticked = mics
92	        guard offeredFor != ticked else { return }
93	        offeredFor = ticked
94	        faces = match?.faces ?? []
95	        for popup in popups { fill(popup) }
96	        if let match, match.sure {
97	            for (n, mic) in assigned.enumerated() where n < match.assignment.count {
98	                guard let row = ticked.firstIndex(of: mic),
99	                    let face = faces.firstIndex(where: { $0.face == match.assignment[n] })
100	                else { continue }
101	                popups[row].selectItem(at: face + 1)
102	            }
103	            note.stringValue = Self.sureNote
104	        } else {
105	            note.stringValue = Self.unsureNote
106	        }
107	    }
108	
109	    // MARK: - Rows
110	
111	    @objc private func tickChanged(_ sender: Any?) {
112	        rebuildRows()
113	        onChange()
114	    }
115	
116	    @objc private func faceChanged(_ sender: Any?) {
117	        onChange()
118	    }
119	
120	    /// One Faces row per ticked microphone, each on "Choose a face" until the next `offer`.
121	    private func rebuildRows() {
122	        for row in facesColumn.arrangedSubviews {
123	            facesColumn.removeArrangedSubview(row)
124	            row.removeFromSuperview()
125	        }
126	        popups = []
127	        faces = []
128	        offeredFor = nil
129	        note.stringValue = ""
130	        for (microphone, box) in zip(microphones, boxes) where box.state == .on {
131	            let name = NSTextField(labelWithString: microphone.name)
132	            name.font = DS.sans(13)
133	            name.textColor = DS.textStrong
134	            name.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 96).isActive = true
135	            name.lineBreakMode = .byTruncatingTail
136	            let popup = NSPopUpButton(frame: .zero, pullsDown: false)
137	            popup.font = DS.sans(13)
138	            popup.target = self
139	            popup.action = #selector(faceChanged(_:))
140	            popup.setAccessibilityIdentifier("vertical.face.\(microphone.track)")
141	            fill(popup)
142	            popups.append(popup)
143	            facesColumn.addArrangedSubview(sheetRow([name, popup]))
144	        }
145	    }
146	
147	    /// "Choose a face", then "Face N (X % across)" per face found, on "Choose a face".
148	    private func fill(_ popup: NSPopUpButton) {
149	        popup.removeAllItems()
150	        popup.addItem(withTitle: Self.chooseTitle)
151	        for face in faces {
152	            popup.addItem(withTitle: "Face \(face.face) (\(Int((face.x * 100).rounded())) % across)")
153	        }
154	        popup.selectItem(at: 0)
155	    }
156	}

344	
345	### Camera layouts
346	
347	A screen recording with a camera in front of it can switch between layouts as
348	it plays. Put the playhead where the switch should happen and choose one from
349	**Clip ▸ Camera Layout ▸**:
350	
351	- **Corner ▸**, **Rounded Corner ▸** and **Circle ▸**, each with **Bottom
352	  Right**, **Bottom Left**, **Top Right** and **Top Left** — the camera in a
353	  box a quarter of the canvas wide and a third tall, 5 % in from the edges, as
354	  a recording lands it. Corner shows the whole camera picture with square
355	  corners, Rounded Corner rounds them, and Circle crops the largest square of
356	  the picture to a circle. The screen fills the canvas as Add Clip places it.
357	- **Side by Side** — the screen fitted in the left two-thirds, the camera
358	  cropped to fill the right third, with a margin around and between them and
359	  slightly rounded corners.
360	- **Stacked** — the screen across the top, the camera cropped to fill the rest
361	  below it.
362	- **Camera Full** — the camera fills the canvas.
363	- **Screen Only** — the camera is hidden where it is (its opacity goes to 0),
364	  and the screen fills the canvas.
365	
366	**Which clips:** with two clips with a picture selected on different tracks,
367	the front one is the camera and the other the screen. With one selected, it is
368	the camera and the screen is the clip drawing behind it at the playhead (the
369	front-most one on a shown track that is not a matte track). With none
370	selected, the camera is the clip at the playhead on the front-most track named
371	"Camera" — the track a recording's camera lands on. The item is greyed when
372	there is no such camera at the playhead, or a sheet is open. It works inside
373	an open nest too. Side by Side and Stacked need a screen; the other three lay
374	out a camera alone.
375	
376	**The switch** eases over half a second from the playhead — a layout action on
377	each clip, which you see on its action lane and can retime like any other. At
378	a clip's first frame it cuts instead: the layout becomes the clip's own
379	placement there. Choosing another layout while one is still easing ends the
380	first where the second begins. One **Undo** takes the whole switch back.
381	
382	**How far it reaches:** a layout holds until the next switch. Every later clip
383	on the camera's track (and on the screen's) that starts before the next layout
384	action on that track takes the layout as its own placement — so a camera cut
385	into pieces stays in the corner — and keeps its own actions.
386	
387	**The Layout section:** with one video clip selected, the Clip tab's Picture
388	sub-tab has a **Layout** section (after Transform and Behind Subject, shut
389	until you open it): **Layout** (Corner, Side by Side, Stacked, Camera Full,
390	Screen Only), **Shape** (Square, Rounded, Circle) and **Corner** (Bottom Right,
391	Bottom Left, Top Right, Top Left) — Shape and Corner only for Corner — a
392	**Duration** for the switch (0.5 s to start, 0.01–10 s) and **Switch at
393	Playhead**, which does exactly what the menu does with this clip as the camera
394	and the clip behind it as the screen. The section's choices stay while the
395	window is open and are not saved; there is no Reset. Pressed with the playhead
396	off the clip, the inspector's foot says the clip does not play there and
397	nothing changes.
398	
399	**Centred on the person:** Circle, Side by Side and Stacked crop the camera.
400	When the camera clip's person masks are already made for every frame it plays
401	— Remove Background makes them, and they stay in the project's cache — the crop
402	centres on the person (the middle of where the masks find them, averaged over
403	the clip) instead of on the middle of the picture. A layout never starts that
404	analysis itself: with no masks, or masks for only part of the clip, the crop
405	centres on the picture.
406	
407	**Zooms:** a switch never fights a zoom. When a clip it would move holds a zoom
408	(or another action that moves it) after the playhead, the switch is refused.
409	A screen that is still at its full placement is not asked in Corner, Camera
410	Full and Screen Only, because those leave it where it is and its zooms keep
411	playing. When nesting those clips would let the switch go ahead, a sheet asks
412	**Lay out the clips in a nest?**, with the reason it was refused: **Nest and
413	Switch** puts the clips in a nest first, so the layout moves the nest and the
414	zooms keep playing inside it — the nest and the layout are one **Undo** —
415	and **Cancel** changes nothing. Otherwise the inspector's foot names the clip
416	and the action. A nest clip shows square corners only, so Rounded Corner and
417	Circle are refused on a nest clip camera.
418	
419	*Agents:* `switch_layout {camera, screen?, layout, shape?, corner?, at,
420	duration?, curve?, focus?, nest?, through?}` — `focus` centres the camera's
421	crop on a point of its picture; left out, it is filled from the camera clip's
422	person masks as the menu fills it, and the answer's `focus` says what was sent
423	(null for none). It is never filled when `nest: true` nests the camera itself.
424	An agent is never offered the sheet: it sends `nest: true` to nest in the same
425	step. `through` stops the layout holding at a time.
426	
427	**In a vertical version:** **File ▸ Make Vertical Version…** keeps the camera
428	layouts: each switch is made again on the new canvas at the same time, length
429	and curve, Side by Side becoming Stacked on a tall canvas, and the camera and
430	screen are never followed (see
431	[Vertical and framing](vertical-and-framing.md#make-vertical-version)). A
432	layout whose camera or screen was moved by hand after the switch is kept as
433	placed and named in the summary. *Agents:* `reframe_clip {follow: "layout",
434	from_width, from_height}` on the camera does the same for one camera.
435

3	/// The nest offer (road map creator-jobs CO7, spec §11 CO-72): a switch the core refused because
4	/// a clip in its reach zooms or moves, offered again as `switch_layout {nest: true}` — the clips
5	/// nested first, so the layout moves the nest and the zoom keeps playing inside it. After R5-3's
6	/// no-footage sheet (`presentNoFootageForTransition` in
7	/// `EditorViewController+InspectorCommands.swift`): the core's sentence verbatim, then what the
8	/// button does. The completion is not an AppKit event, so Nest and Switch commits through
9	/// `performGroupedEdit` (app/CLAUDE.md's undo pitfall): ONE op, one undo step "Camera Layout".
10	enum LayoutOfferSheet {
11	    static let nestTitle = "Nest and Switch"
12	    static let title = "Lay out the clips in a nest?"
13	    static let explanation =
14	        "Nest and Switch puts those clips in a nest first, so the layout moves the nest and the "
15	        + "zoom keeps playing inside it. One Undo takes both back."
16	
17	    /// Puts the offer on `window`. `nested` is the op Nest and Switch sends, its focus already
18	    /// decided (`CameraLayoutCommand.keepsFocus`, CO-70).
19	    static func present(
20	        refusal: ReelRefusal, nested: ReelOp, document: ProjectDocument, window: NSWindow
21	    ) {
22	        let alert = NSAlert()
23	        alert.messageText = title
24	        alert.informativeText = refusal.reason + "\n\n" + explanation
25	        alert.addButton(withTitle: nestTitle)
26	        let cancel = alert.addButton(withTitle: "Cancel")
27	        cancel.keyEquivalent = "\u{1b}"
28	        alert.beginSheetModal(for: window) { [weak document] response in
29	            guard response == .alertFirstButtonReturn, let document else { return }
30	            document.performGroupedEdit(CameraLayoutCommand.actionName, [nested])
31	        }
32	    }
33	}

1	import AppKit
2	
3	/// Make Vertical's copy (spec §11 VR-30, VR-31; road map "creator-jobs" VR3a): CJ5b's derived
4	/// document handed the source's handle unchanged (`range: nil`, so every media stays and
5	/// every cache and analysis is carried), named "<source> (<shape>)", with the step applied
6	/// there as its one undo step, "Make Vertical". The source is never edited and gains no undo
7	/// step. Its doors are `make_vertical_version` (`AgentServer+VerticalVersion.swift`) and File ▸
8	/// Make Vertical Version… (`EditorViewController+VerticalVersion.swift`, VR3b). In the copy,
9	/// and only there, the project's own older copies of the bundled templates are rewritten with
10	/// the current text (VR-44 (c), `VerticalVersion+Layers.swift`).
11	extension ProjectDocument {
12	
13	    /// The copy, what was carried and the template report. Main only. A copy the step did not
14	    /// change is closed, its package at `path` removed, and the call refused.
15	    static func verticalCopy(
16	        from source: ProjectDocument, plan: VerticalVersion.Plan, shape: VerticalShape,
17	        path: URL?, display: Bool
18	    ) throws -> (
19	        document: ProjectDocument, carried: DerivedCarry.Report,
20	        templates: VerticalVersion.TemplateReport
21	    ) {
22	        assert(Thread.isMainThread)
23	        let made = try derived(
24	            from: source, handle: source.project, range: nil, path: path, display: display,
25	            name: "\(source.displayStem) (\(shape.rawValue))")
26	        let opened = made.document.project
27	        made.document.performGroupedEdit(VerticalVersion.actionName, plan.ops)
28	        guard made.document.project !== opened else {
29	            made.document.close()
30	            if let path { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: path) }
31	            throw ReelCoreError(
32	                message: "Make Vertical did not apply to the copy, so nothing was made.")
33	        }
34	        var templates = VerticalVersion.TemplateReport()
35	        if let store = made.document.graphicStore {
36	            let survey = VerticalVersion.templateSurvey(made.document.project, store: store)
37	            templates = VerticalVersion.updateTemplates(
38	                survey, in: store, from: GraphicTemplates.bundledDirectory)
39	        }
40	        return (made.document, made.carried, templates)
41	    }
42	}

3	/// Make Vertical's copy (spec §11 VR-30, VR-31; road map "creator-jobs" VR3a): CJ5b's derived
4	/// document handed the source's handle unchanged (`range: nil`, so every media stays and
5	/// every cache and analysis is carried), named "<source> (<shape>)", with the step applied
6	/// there as its one undo step, "Make Vertical". The source is never edited and gains no undo
7	/// step. Its doors are `make_vertical_version` (`AgentServer+VerticalVersion.swift`) and File ▸
8	/// Make Vertical Version… (`EditorViewController+VerticalVersion.swift`, VR3b). In the copy,
9	/// and only there, the project's own older copies of the bundled templates are rewritten with
10	/// the current text (VR-44 (c), `VerticalVersion+Layers.swift`).
11	extension ProjectDocument {
12	
13	    /// The copy, what was carried and the template report. Main only. A copy the step did not
14	    /// change is closed, its package at `path` removed, and the call refused.
15	    static func verticalCopy(
16	        from source: ProjectDocument, plan: VerticalVersion.Plan, shape: VerticalShape,
17	        path: URL?, display: Bool
18	    ) throws -> (
19	        document: ProjectDocument, carried: DerivedCarry.Report,
20	        templates: VerticalVersion.TemplateReport
21	    ) {
22	        assert(Thread.isMainThread)
23	        let made = try derived(
24	            from: source, handle: source.project, range: nil, path: path, display: display,
25	            name: "\(source.displayStem) (\(shape.rawValue))")
26	        let opened = made.document.project
27	        made.document.performGroupedEdit(VerticalVersion.actionName, plan.ops)
28	        guard made.document.project !== opened else {
29	            made.document.close()
30	            if let path { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: path) }
31	            throw ReelCoreError(
32	                message: "Make Vertical did not apply to the copy, so nothing was made.")
33	        }
34	        var templates = VerticalVersion.TemplateReport()
35	        if let store = made.document.graphicStore {
36	            let survey = VerticalVersion.templateSurvey(made.document.project, store: store)
37	            templates = VerticalVersion.updateTemplates(
38	                survey, in: store, from: GraphicTemplates.bundledDirectory)
39	        }
40	        return (made.document, made.carried, templates)
41	    }
42	}

336	    /// VR-66 (c): the ticked set's reading, a ready one cached and offered to the picker at every
337	    /// refresh (`offer` presets a set once, so a repeat does nothing until the set is ticked
338	    /// again and its rows rebuilt); a refused one read again at every refresh.
339	    private func reading(_ settings: VerticalSettings) -> VerticalVersion.SpeakerReading {
340	        let key = settings.mics
341	        if let cached = readings[key] {
342	            if case .ready(_, _, let match) = cached.read { picker.offer(match, mics: cached.mics) }
343	            return cached.read
344	        }
345	        guard let document else { return .refused("") }
346	        var unconfirmed = settings
347	        unconfirmed.micFaces = nil
348	        let read = VerticalVersion.speakerReading(
349	            document: document, project: document.project, settings: unconfirmed,
350	            subjects: subjects ?? [:], missing: missing)
351	        guard case .ready(_, let reference, let match) = read else { return read }
352	        // The reference's own microphones named back as the ticked ones, track by track.
353	        let snapshot = document.project.snapshot
354	        let own = VerticalVersion.speakerClips(
355	            document.project, settings: unconfirmed, missing: missing
356	        ).first { $0.clip == reference }?.mics ?? []
357	        let byTrack = Dictionary(
358	            key.compactMap { id in snapshot.clip(id).map { ($0.track, id) } },
359	            uniquingKeysWith: { first, _ in first })
360	        let mics = own.map { snapshot.clip($0).flatMap { byTrack[$0.track] } ?? $0 }
361	        readings[key] = (read, mics)
362	        picker.offer(match, mics: mics)
363	        return read
364	    }

370	        do {
371	            let read = settings.follow == .speaker
372	                ? (speakerSubjects ?? [:])
373	                : VerticalVersion.analyses(settings.follow) ? (subjects ?? [:]) : [:]
374	            switch try VerticalVersion.plan(
375	                document.project, settings: settings, subjects: read, missing: missing)
376	            {
377	            case .plan(let plan):
378	                let report = VerticalVersion.templateReport(
379	                    templates, copy: copyBox.state == .on)
380	                return (!plan.ops.isEmpty, VerticalVersion.summary(plan, templates: report))
381	            case .refused(let why): return (false, why)
382	            }
383	        } catch {
384	            return (false, error.localizedDescription)
385	        }
386	    }

433	            settings: settings, copy: copyBox.state == .on, targets: following ? present : [],
434	            cursor: following ? cursor : [], missing: missing, requests: analyzing ? requests : [],
435	            subjects: analyzing || !following ? [:] : (read ?? [:]), asked: asked,
436	            scope: askedScope)
437	        dismiss(self)
438	    }
439	}

3	/// What the Make Vertical Version sheet's Make hands the editor (spec §11 VR-39 (f)): once, on
4	/// the main queue's next turn after `viewDidDisappear`; never after Cancel.
5	struct VerticalHandOff {
6	    let settings: VerticalSettings
7	    let copy: Bool
8	    /// `present` for a following kind, [] for Center.
9	    let targets: [UInt32]
10	    /// `analysisTargets`' `cursor` for a following kind, [] for Center (spec §11 VR-51).
11	    let cursor: [UInt32]
12	    let missing: Set<UInt32>
13	    /// The missing analyses; [] when none or Center.
14	    let requests: [AnalysisRequest]
15	    /// What the sheet read, the cursor's beside the analysis's; [:] when `requests` is
16	    /// non-empty or Center.
17	    let subjects: [UInt32: [String: Any]]
18	    /// `document.project` when `analysisTargets` ran (`viewDidAppear`).
19	    let asked: ReelProject
20	    /// `document.scope` at the same moment.
21	    let scope: UInt32?
22	}

24	/// File ▸ Make Vertical Version… (road map "creator-jobs" VR3b, spec §11 VR-39 (b)–(f), (h)):
25	/// VR3a's step over the top-level timeline (`VerticalVersion.plan`), opened as a copy or applied
26	/// in place by the editor (`EditorViewController+VerticalVersion.swift`); the tool is
27	/// `make_vertical_version` (`AgentServer+VerticalVersion.swift`).
28	///
29	/// Shape (the sizes `VerticalVersion.offered` lists), Follow, Zoom (100–400 %, opening at 100 %,
30	/// never remembered), Where Empty (off while Follow is Center), Make a copy (ticked, never
31	/// remembered), then the summary. Follow and Where Empty are VR-29 (c)'s two keys, opened from
32	/// `VerticalVersion.remembered` (so a stored Speaker opens here) and written through
33	/// `FollowSubjectSettings.remember`.
34	///
35	/// **Speaker** (road map creator-jobs VR6b, spec §11 VR-66) shows `VerticalSpeakerPicker`: the
36	/// microphone tracks, the ticked ones' Face pop-ups and a note. Its reading
37	/// (`VerticalVersion.speakerReading`: the turns, then the core's match on the reference clip) is
38	/// made on main and cached per ticked set only when ready; a refused one is read again at each
39	/// refresh. Make passes the ticked `mics` and the confirmed `micFaces`. A sheet presented again
40	/// after its analysis (`restoring`) opens on the hand-off's shape, follow, zoom, where empty,
41	/// copy and ticked microphones. At `viewDidAppear` the sheet splits the media pictures by
42	/// `analysisTargets` and asks `FramingAnalysis.requests` what is missing. With nothing missing it
43	/// reads the subjects off main ("Reading the analysis…", Make disabled) and plans on main at
44	/// every change; with something missing a following kind shows the pending summary. Center
45	/// reads no subjects, so it plans at once and never analyzes. Make remembers, dismisses and
46	/// hands a `VerticalHandOff` to the editor: the sheet itself never edits and never opens a
47	/// window.
48	///
49	/// **The dev accept** (`-RCDevVerticalAccept YES`, or `in-place`, which unticks Make a copy
50	/// first; dev tools only): the sheet presses Make once, the first time Make is enabled after the
51	/// first summary (AU-128's precedent).
52	final class VerticalVersionSheetController: NSViewController, NSTextFieldDelegate {
53	    /// The dev-only launch default that presses Make.
54	    static let devAcceptKey = "RCDevVerticalAccept"
55	    /// Its value that unticks Make a copy before pressing Make.
56	    static let devAcceptInPlace = "in-place"
57	    /// `VerticalVersion.follows`' titles, in its order.
58	    private static let followTitles = [
59	        "Subject", "Faces", "People", "Salient Region", "Speaker", "Center",
60	    ]
61	    private static let whereEmpties: [(String, FramingWhereEmpty)] = [
62	        ("Show Whole", .fit), ("Center", .center),
63	    ]
64	
65	    private weak var document: ProjectDocument?
66	    private let make: (VerticalHandOff) -> Void
67	    private let opened: FollowSubjectSettings
68	    /// The hand-off this sheet is presented again from, after its analysis (VR-66 (e)).
69	    private let restoring: VerticalHandOff?
70	    private let picker: VerticalSpeakerPicker
71	    /// Speaker's ready readings, per ticked set, each with the reference's microphones named
72	    /// back as the ticked ones, so a set ticked again is offered its match again (VR-66 (c)).
73	    private var readings: [[UInt32]: (read: VerticalVersion.SpeakerReading, mics: [UInt32])] = [:]
74	    /// The subjects with their turns the current Speaker plan read.
75	    private var speakerSubjects: [UInt32: [String: Any]]?
76	    private let shapes: [VerticalShape]
77	    private let canvas: CanvasSnapshot
78	    private var present: [UInt32] = []
79	    private var cursor: [UInt32] = []
80	    private var missing: Set<UInt32> = []
81	    private var requests: [AnalysisRequest] = []
82	    private var requestError: String?
83	    private var subjects: [UInt32: [String: Any]]?
84	    private var asked: ReelProject?
85	    /// VR-44 (b)'s survey of the project's graphic modules, made once at `viewDidAppear`.
86	    private var templates = VerticalVersion.TemplateSurvey()
87	    private var askedScope: UInt32?
88	    private var accepted = false
89	    /// Set by Make: handed to `make` after disappearing.
90	    private var handOff: VerticalHandOff?
91	
92	    private let shapePopup = NSPopUpButton(frame: .zero, pullsDown: false)
93	    private let followPopup = NSPopUpButton(frame: .zero, pullsDown: false)
94	    private let whereEmptyPopup = NSPopUpButton(frame: .zero, pullsDown: false)
95	    private let zoomField = NSTextField(string: "")
96	    private let copyBox = NSButton(checkboxWithTitle: "Make a copy", target: nil, action: nil)
97	    private let summaryLabel = NSTextField(wrappingLabelWithString: "")
98	    private var makeButton: NSButton?
99	
100	    init(
101	        document: ProjectDocument, restoring: VerticalHandOff? = nil,
102	        make: @escaping (VerticalHandOff) -> Void
103	    ) {
104	        self.document = document
105	        self.make = make
106	        self.opened = VerticalVersion.remembered(.standard)
107	        self.restoring = restoring
108	        self.canvas = document.project.snapshot.canvas
109	        self.shapes = VerticalVersion.offered(canvas)
110	        let ticked = restoring.map(\.settings.mics).flatMap { $0.isEmpty ? nil : $0 }
111	        let relay = PickerRelay()
112	        self.picker = VerticalSpeakerPicker(
113	            microphones: VerticalVersion.microphones(document.project), ticked: ticked,
114	            onChange: { relay.changed?() })
115	        super.init(nibName: nil, bundle: nil)
116	        relay.changed = { [weak self] in self?.refresh() }
117	    }
118	
119	    /// The picker's change, handed to the sheet once it exists.
120	    private final class PickerRelay {
121	        var changed: (() -> Void)?
122	    }
123	
124	    @available(*, unavailable)
125	    required init?(coder: NSCoder) {
126	        fatalError("VerticalVersionSheetController does not support NSCoder")
127	    }

130	
131	    override func loadView() {
132	        for shape in shapes {
133	            let size = shape.size(from: canvas)
134	            shapePopup.addItem(withTitle: "\(shape.rawValue) (\(size.width) × \(size.height))")
135	        }
136	        let start = restoring?.settings
137	        shapePopup.selectItem(at: start.flatMap { shapes.firstIndex(of: $0.shape) } ?? 0)
138	        for title in Self.followTitles { followPopup.addItem(withTitle: title) }
139	        followPopup.selectItem(
140	            at: VerticalVersion.follows.firstIndex(of: start?.follow ?? opened.follow) ?? 0)
141	        for (title, _) in Self.whereEmpties { whereEmptyPopup.addItem(withTitle: title) }
142	        let empty = start?.whereEmpty ?? opened.whereEmpty
143	        whereEmptyPopup.selectItem(at: Self.whereEmpties.firstIndex { $0.1 == empty } ?? 0)
144	        for (popup, id) in [
145	            (shapePopup, "vertical.shape"), (followPopup, "vertical.follow"),
146	            (whereEmptyPopup, "vertical.whereEmpty"),
147	        ] {
148	            popup.font = DS.sans(13)
149	            popup.target = self
150	            popup.action = #selector(controlChanged(_:))
151	            popup.setAccessibilityIdentifier(id)
152	        }
153	
154	        let formatter = NumberFormatter()
155	        formatter.numberStyle = .decimal
156	        formatter.allowsFloats = false
157	        formatter.minimum = NSNumber(value: FollowSubjectSettings.zoomRange.lowerBound * 100)
158	        formatter.maximum = NSNumber(value: FollowSubjectSettings.zoomRange.upperBound * 100)
159	        zoomField.formatter = formatter

192	            title: "Make Vertical Version",
193	            hint: "Makes a version of the timeline for a tall or square canvas. Each full-frame "
194	                + "movie clip follows its subject with eased moves (with Speaker, whoever is "
195	                + "talking on the ticked microphones), stills and nests are "
196	                + "centred, and everything else is kept as placed, with a blurred copy behind a "
197	                + "clip where it shows the whole picture. With Make a copy it opens as a new "
198	                + "project and this one does not change. One undo step.",
199	            content: sheetColumn([grid, picker.view, summaryLabel]),
200	            buttonRow: makeButtonRow(cancel: cancel, apply: make))
201	        whereEmptyPopup.isEnabled = follow.follow != .center
202	        picker.view.isHidden = follow.follow != .speaker
203	    }

205	    /// VR-39 (d): the targets and the requests, once, on the project and scope the hand-off
206	    /// carries.
207	    override func viewDidAppear() {
208	        super.viewDidAppear()
209	        guard asked == nil, let document else { return }
210	        let project = document.project
211	        asked = project
212	        askedScope = document.scope
213	        let targets = VerticalVersion.analysisTargets(project, urls: document.mediaURLs())
214	        present = targets.present
215	        missing = targets.missing
216	        cursor = targets.cursor
217	        templates = VerticalVersion.templateSurvey(project, store: document.graphicStore)
218	        do {
219	            requests = try FramingAnalysis.requests(clips: present, in: document, project: project)
220	        } catch {
221	            requestError = error.localizedDescription
222	        }
223	        if requestError == nil, requests.isEmpty {
224	            // The cache folder is needed only for the analysed pictures; a cursor is read
225	            // from its own file (VR-51).
226	            let cacheDir = present.isEmpty ? nil : document.cacheDirectory
227	            let clips = cacheDir == nil ? [] : present
228	            let cursorClips = cursor
229	            if clips.isEmpty, cursorClips.isEmpty {
230	                subjects = [:]
231	            } else {
232	                DispatchQueue.global(qos: .userInitiated).async { [weak self] in
233	                    var read = cacheDir.map {
234	                        FollowSubject.subjects(clips, in: project, cacheDir: $0)
235	                    } ?? [:]
236	                    read.merge(FramingCursor.subjects(cursorClips, in: project)) { _, new in new }
237	                    DispatchQueue.main.async { self?.didRead(read) }
238	                }
239	            }
240	        }
241	        refresh()
242	    }
243	
244	    private func didRead(_ read: [UInt32: [String: Any]]) {
245	        subjects = read
246	        refresh()
247	    }
248	
249	    /// The one hand-back: once, after the sheet is gone, never after Cancel.
250	    override func viewDidDisappear() {
251	        super.viewDidDisappear()
252	        guard let handOff else { return }
253	        self.handOff = nil
254	        let make = self.make
255	        DispatchQueue.main.async { make(handOff) }
256	    }

258	    // MARK: - Values
259	
260	    /// What the follow controls say, Zoom inside its range: VR-29's settings, remembered as theirs.
261	    private var follow: FollowSubjectSettings {
262	        let range = FollowSubjectSettings.zoomRange
263	        let percent = Double(zoomField.integerValue)
264	        let follow = VerticalVersion.follows[max(0, followPopup.indexOfSelectedItem)]
265	        let empty = Self.whereEmpties[max(0, whereEmptyPopup.indexOfSelectedItem)].1
266	        return FollowSubjectSettings(
267	            follow: follow, zoom: min(max(percent / 100, range.lowerBound), range.upperBound),
268	            whereEmpty: empty)
269	    }
270	
271	    /// The step's settings: the chosen shape and the follow controls, with Speaker the ticked
272	    /// microphones and their confirmed faces.
273	    private func settings(_ follow: FollowSubjectSettings) -> VerticalSettings? {
274	        guard !shapes.isEmpty else { return nil }
275	        let shape = shapes[min(max(0, shapePopup.indexOfSelectedItem), shapes.count - 1)]
276	        let speaker = follow.follow == .speaker
277	        return VerticalSettings(
278	            shape: shape, follow: follow.follow, zoom: follow.zoom, whereEmpty: follow.whereEmpty,
279	            mics: speaker ? picker.mics : [], micFaces: speaker ? picker.micFaces : nil)
280	    }
281	
282	    /// Whether Make hands the analysis on: an analysing follow with requests missing.
283	    private func pending(_ follow: FollowSubjectSettings) -> Bool {
284	        VerticalVersion.analyses(follow.follow) && requestError == nil && !requests.isEmpty
285	    }
286	
287	    /// Says what Make would do and enables it: the request error, the pending summary,
288	    /// "Reading the analysis…", or the plan made on main over the document's current handle.
289	    private func refresh() {
290	        let follow = self.follow
291	        let analysing = VerticalVersion.analyses(follow.follow)
292	        let speaker = follow.follow == .speaker
293	        whereEmptyPopup.isEnabled = follow.follow != .center
294	        picker.view.isHidden = !speaker
295	        speakerSubjects = nil
296	        var enabled = false
297	        if let settings = settings(follow) {
298	            let ticked = (2...VerticalSpeakerPicker.mostMicrophones).contains(settings.mics.count)
299	            if analysing, let requestError {
300	                summaryLabel.stringValue = requestError
301	            } else if speaker, let document,
302	                VerticalVersion.speakerClips(document.project, settings: settings, missing: missing)
303	                    .isEmpty
304	            {
305	                summaryLabel.stringValue = VerticalVersion.noSpeakerClipSheet
306	            } else if pending(follow) {
307	                let size = settings.shape.size(from: canvas)
308	                summaryLabel.stringValue = VerticalVersion.pendingSummary(
309	                    files: Set(requests.map(\.media.id)).count, width: size.width,
310	                    height: size.height, speaker: speaker)
311	                enabled = !speaker || ticked
312	            } else if analysing, subjects == nil {
313	                summaryLabel.stringValue = FollowSubjectSheetController.reading
314	            } else if speaker {
315	                switch reading(settings) {
316	                case .refused(let why):
317	                    summaryLabel.stringValue = why
318	                case .ready(let read, _, _):
319	                    // Read again: the reading's first offer may have preset the faces.
320	                    let confirmed = self.settings(follow) ?? settings
321	                    speakerSubjects = read
322	                    let (made, text) = planned(confirmed)
323	                    summaryLabel.stringValue = text
324	                    enabled = made && ticked && confirmed.micFaces != nil
325	                }
326	            } else {
327	                let (made, text) = planned(settings)
328	                summaryLabel.stringValue = text
329	                enabled = made
330	            }
331	        }
332	        makeButton?.isEnabled = enabled
333	        acceptIfAsked()
334	    }
335	
336	    /// VR-66 (c): the ticked set's reading, a ready one cached and offered to the picker at every
337	    /// refresh (`offer` presets a set once, so a repeat does nothing until the set is ticked
338	    /// again and its rows rebuilt); a refused one read again at every refresh.
339	    private func reading(_ settings: VerticalSettings) -> VerticalVersion.SpeakerReading {
340	        let key = settings.mics
341	        if let cached = readings[key] {
342	            if case .ready(_, _, let match) = cached.read { picker.offer(match, mics: cached.mics) }
343	            return cached.read
344	        }
345	        guard let document else { return .refused("") }
346	        var unconfirmed = settings
347	        unconfirmed.micFaces = nil
348	        let read = VerticalVersion.speakerReading(
349	            document: document, project: document.project, settings: unconfirmed,
350	            subjects: subjects ?? [:], missing: missing)
351	        guard case .ready(_, let reference, let match) = read else { return read }
352	        // The reference's own microphones named back as the ticked ones, track by track.
353	        let snapshot = document.project.snapshot
354	        let own = VerticalVersion.speakerClips(
355	            document.project, settings: unconfirmed, missing: missing
356	        ).first { $0.clip == reference }?.mics ?? []
357	        let byTrack = Dictionary(
358	            key.compactMap { id in snapshot.clip(id).map { ($0.track, id) } },
359	            uniquingKeysWith: { first, _ in first })
360	        let mics = own.map { snapshot.clip($0).flatMap { byTrack[$0.track] } ?? $0 }
361	        readings[key] = (read, mics)
362	        picker.offer(match, mics: mics)
363	        return read
364	    }
365	
366	    /// `VerticalVersion.plan` on the document's current handle: whether it makes anything, and
367	    /// its summary or the refusal.
368	    private func planned(_ settings: VerticalSettings) -> (Bool, String) {
369	        guard let document else { return (false, "") }
370	        do {
371	            let read = settings.follow == .speaker
372	                ? (speakerSubjects ?? [:])
373	                : VerticalVersion.analyses(settings.follow) ? (subjects ?? [:]) : [:]
374	            switch try VerticalVersion.plan(
375	                document.project, settings: settings, subjects: read, missing: missing)
376	            {
377	            case .plan(let plan):
378	                let report = VerticalVersion.templateReport(
379	                    templates, copy: copyBox.state == .on)
380	                return (!plan.ops.isEmpty, VerticalVersion.summary(plan, templates: report))
381	            case .refused(let why): return (false, why)
382	            }
383	        } catch {
384	            return (false, error.localizedDescription)
385	        }
386	    }
387	
388	    /// The dev accept: Make pressed once, async, the first time it is enabled with the sheet up;
389	    /// `in-place` unticks Make a copy first.
390	    private func acceptIfAsked() {
391	        #if FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS
392	        guard makeButton?.isEnabled == true, !accepted, view.window != nil else { return }
393	        let defaults = UserDefaults.standard
394	        let inPlace = defaults.string(forKey: Self.devAcceptKey) == Self.devAcceptInPlace
395	        guard inPlace || defaults.bool(forKey: Self.devAcceptKey) else { return }
396	        accepted = true
397	        if inPlace { copyBox.state = .off }
398	        DispatchQueue.main.async { [weak self] in self?.makeClicked(nil) }
399	        #endif
400	    }
401	
402	    // MARK: - Controls
403	
404	    @objc private func controlChanged(_ sender: Any?) {
405	        refresh()
406	    }
407	
408	    func controlTextDidEndEditing(_ obj: Notification) {
409	        let range = FollowSubjectSettings.zoomRange
410	        let percent = Double(zoomField.integerValue)
411	        zoomField.integerValue = Int(
412	            min(max(percent, range.lowerBound * 100), range.upperBound * 100))
413	        refresh()
414	    }
415	
416	    // MARK: - Commit
417	
418	    @objc private func cancelClicked(_ sender: Any?) {
419	        dismiss(self)
420	    }
421	
422	    /// Writes the remembered keys, dismisses and hands the editor what it needs: the plan is
423	    /// made again there, on the current handle, after the project check (VR-39 (f), (g)).
424	    @objc private func makeClicked(_ sender: Any?) {
425	        guard makeButton?.isEnabled == true, let asked else { return }
426	        let follow = self.follow
427	        guard let settings = settings(follow) else { return }
428	        let following = VerticalVersion.analyses(follow.follow)
429	        let analyzing = pending(follow)
430	        follow.remember(changedFrom: opened, in: .standard)
431	        let read = follow.follow == .speaker ? speakerSubjects : subjects
432	        handOff = VerticalHandOff(
433	            settings: settings, copy: copyBox.state == .on, targets: following ? present : [],
434	            cursor: following ? cursor : [], missing: missing, requests: analyzing ? requests : [],
435	            subjects: analyzing || !following ? [:] : (read ?? [:]), asked: asked,
436	            scope: askedScope)
437	        dismiss(self)
438	    }
439	}

# core/CLAUDE.md — Rust core rules

Applies to everything under `core/`. Build commands and the FFI three-file
lockstep are in the root `CLAUDE.md`; the full design is
`designs/spec/` (§5 the schemas, §6 the op table, §7 the architecture,
§7.10 this module map in the spec's words; its `README.md` is the index). The long form of
each entry below — why the seam fell where it did — is
`designs/adr/core-file-history.md` (the full history of every cut, with its
line counts, is archived; see its "Original" line); this file is what
governs a module now.

## Module map

- `lib.rs` — module declarations and re-exports only. No implementation code.
- `model.rs` — the spec §5.2 SHAPE: the project, its clips, sources,
  actions, markers and nests (a track is `model_track.rs` and the media
  types `model_media.rs`, both re-exported), with
  the serde defaults that say what an absent key means. The struct field
  names ARE the JSON keys. Nothing else lives here but `CanvasOutput`
  (`Canvas.output`, `sdr` or `hlg`, written only when `hlg`, format 23, spec
  §11 HD-2).
- `model_canvas.rs` — `CanvasBlending` (`Canvas.blending`, `encoded` or
  `linear`, written only when `linear`, format 24, spec §11 GR-18, HD-16),
  re-exported by `model.rs`; the recipe canvas carries it only when linear.
- `model_track.rs` — a track (`Track`, spec §5.2's `tracks[]` and a nest's),
  moved out of `model.rs` whole (road map "audio" AP10's toll T1) and
  re-exported by it; the track vocabulary's new keys land here: format 35's
  `volume` (0…`TRACK_VOLUME_MAX`, 4, written only when not 1) and `pan`
  (−1…1, written only when not 0), spec §11 AU-102, and format 36's
  `compressor` and `limiter` (the clip's `model_audio.rs` types, after `pan`,
  written only when set), spec §11 AU-150.
- `model_media.rs` — the media types (`Media`, `MediaOriginal`, `MediaKind`,
  spec §5.2's `media[]`), moved out of `model.rs` whole (road map
  "creator-jobs" CJ0b's toll T2) and re-exported by it, so every
  `crate::model::Media*` path holds; a media record's new keys land here.
- `model_props.rs` — the schema's VOCABULARY: the per-clip property types
  (`VideoProps`, `Crop`, `Shadow`, `ColorAdjust`, `Chroma`, `Filter`,
  `Reflection`, `BlendMode`) and their defaults (the audio group's are
  `model_audio.rs`'s), re-exported whole by `model.rs` so every
  `crate::model::X` path holds. **`BlendMode`'s, `ObscureKind`'s and
  `TrackMatte`'s declaration ORDER are shader discriminants** (`ProjectSnapshot.swift` and
  `TrackMatte.swift` derive the code from the case index, `Compositor.metal`
  compares against the same integers): append,
  never reorder. `Normal` is 0 with no `+1`, so a zeroed uniform block, an
  older recipe and a file with no `blend` key all render source-over.
- `model_audio.rs` — the audio vocabulary: `AudioProps`, `Compressor`,
  `Limiter` (format 30, spec §11 AU-21, written only when set) and `Duck`
  (with format 29's `DuckMode`, `pre_roll`, `hold` and `DUCK_SPEECH_PAD`)
  and `FadeShape` (`fade_in_shape` / `fade_out_shape`, and
  `Transition.audio_shape`), and their defaults, every format-29 key
  written only when not its default, and `AudioProps.isolation` (format
  31, spec §11 AU-50, 0…1, written only when not 0), and format 32's
  `Equalizer` (seven named slots — `HighPass`, `LowShelf`, `EqBand` × 3,
  `HighShelf`, `LowPass` — and `bypass`), `Hum` and `AudioChannels` (spec §11
  AU-31, AU-33, AU-34, each written only when set, `channels` only when not
  `both`), and format 33's `Gate` and `DeEsser` (`audio.gate`,
  `audio.de_esser`, spec §11 AU-43, AU-45, after `channels`, each written only
  when set), and format 34's `Voice` (`audio.voice`, spec §11 AU-140, after
  `de_esser`, written only when set: a `VoiceKind` with no default, an
  `amount` defaulting to `VOICE_DEFAULT_AMOUNT`, an optional `pitch`; its
  ranges in `props_check.rs`, its clamp in `actions_clamp.rs`, the chains
  Swift's), and format 37's `Leveller` (`audio.leveller`, spec §11 AU-66:
  `target_db`, `max_up_db`, `max_down_db`, `response`, after `voice`, written
  only when set; its bounds `audio_dynamics.rs`'s); the FIELD `Clip.audio`
  stays in `model.rs`. Re-exported through
  `model_props.rs`; a pure move out of it (road map "audio" AP0), so the audio
  group's new keys land here.
- `audio_eq.rs` — the EQ's and the hum notch's bounds (format 32, spec §11
  AU-31, AU-33, AU-37): `check_eq` / `check_hum`, run by `props_check.rs`'s
  `check_audio` and refusing in the key's own sentence (`audio.eq.<slot>.frequency
  must be between 20 and 20000, not 5`, a slope that is not 12 or 24, mains not
  50 or 60), and `clamp_eq` / `clamp_hum`, run by `actions_clamp.rs`'s
  `clamp_audio` on an action's end. No sample work; the stage is Swift's.
- `audio_dynamics.rs` — the gate's, the de-esser's and the leveller's bounds
  (format 33, spec §11 AU-43, AU-45, AU-46; format 37, AU-66): `check_gate` /
  `check_de_esser` / `check_leveller`, run by
  `props_check.rs`'s `check_audio` and refusing in the key's own sentence
  (`audio.gate.ratio must be between 1 and 20, not 21`; times through
  `props_check.rs`'s `ticks_in_range`), `check_compressor` /
  `check_limiter` (under a prefix: `audio.` for the clip's, run by
  `check_audio`, and the track's own key for `track_dynamics.rs`, spec §11
